name: 10901 · Suffern, NY
findings: ZIP 10901 (Suffern) has 199 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10901 (Suffern) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10901 (Suffern) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
